title: Open-closed localization for relative etale compact support
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. Work in the bounded-below derived categories of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For any separated finite-type morphism $h:T\to B$ of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], a compactification $c=(j:T\hookrightarrow\overline T,p:\overline T\to B)$ consists of a quasi-compact open immersion $j$ and a proper morphism $p$ with $h=pj$ [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]; write $Rh_!^c=Rp_*j_!$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be such a morphism, let $j_U:U\hookrightarrow X$ be a quasi-compact open immersion with closed complement $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], and put $g=fj_U$, $h=fi$. For every $K\in D^+(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ and compactifications $c_f,c_g,c_h$ there is a distinguished triangle $Rg_!^{c_g}j_U^{-1}K\to Rf_!^{c_f}K\to Rh_!^{c_h}i^{-1}K\to (Rg_!^{c_g}j_U^{-1}K)[1]$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Its cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] fit in the exact sequence $\cdots\to\mathcal H^q(Rg_!^{c_g}j_U^{-1}K)\to\mathcal H^q(Rf_!^{c_f}K)\to\mathcal H^q(Rh_!^{c_h}i^{-1}K)\to\mathcal H^{q+1}(Rg_!^{c_g}j_U^{-1}K)\to\cdots$.

proof.text: Obtain CompactSpace U and CompactSpace Z by QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace applied to j and i. Obtain QuasiSeparatedSpace U and QuasiSeparatedSpace Z by quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated. The open and closed immersion instances supply separatedness, local finite type and quasi-compactness required by compact-support composition. Closed immersions are finite and proper; no finite generation of their ideal is assumed.

Use exists_functorial_distTriang_openClosed for j, i and hij, and evaluate its boundary at K. Let S be its distinguished triangle in the bounded-below derived category, with terms j_!j^*K, K and i_*i^*K. Only the existence and distinguishedness clauses are needed, not the naturality clause.

Compactify j by Compactification.ofIsOpenImmersion j and i by Compactification.ofIsProper i. For the first, rightDerivedFunctorPlusNatIso(lowerStarId) followed by rightDerivedFunctorPlusIdIso identifies the identity derived direct image with identity. For the second, uniqueness of left adjoints and upperStarId identify extension by zero along identity with identity; descend that isomorphism termwise. Finite direct image is exact, so rightDerivedFunctorPlusIsoMapDerivedCategoryPlus identifies Ri_* with the termwise derived i_*. Apply the stated qcqs compact-support composition theorem for j followed by f and i followed by f. Evaluate the resulting natural isomorphisms on j^*K and i^*K.

proof.text: Let F be the bounded-below compact-support functor attached to c_f, and G its composite with the inclusion into the ambient derived category. Extension by zero is exact and the bounded-below derived direct image is triangulated, so G is triangulated. Set T = G.mapTriangle.obj S. Its distinguishedness is G.map_distinguished S. Apply F and then the inclusion to the vertex isomorphisms in the preceding step, and compose with the evaluated composition isomorphisms. These give the three Nonempty vertex isomorphisms required in the statement; the middle one is Iso.refl. No transport of the triangle itself is necessary because its vertices are specified up to isomorphism.

proof.text: For each integer q, functoriality of homology and the zero composite of the first two arrows of a distinguished triangle give z2. Use DerivedCategory.HomologySequence.comp_δ and δ_comp for z3 and z1. Apply exact₂, exact₃ and exact₁ to T and its distinguishedness to obtain exactness at all three positions, with the connecting map exactly HomologySequence.δ T q (q+1). The abelian and enough-injective instances for Sheaf(smallEtaleTopology, ModuleCat Λ) already come from the source library; the separate SheafOfModules encoding is not needed.

The delivery is a repair of the long-step return: the item and its report only, no new nodes, and statement, stmt_deps, lean record and tool_uses unchanged. The old 2030-char step is now steps 1-3. Step 1 proves U and Z qcqs from qcqs-permanence(2), both clauses of the affine-cover criterion and closed-in-quasi-compact; V_a∩V_b is never assumed affine. Step 2 gives j_U finite type from the qc-open-immersion leaf, writes out the open-immersion diagonal (elementary), gets g separated and LFT from proper-fp-permanence(e), and g quasi-compact from permanence(1) since Y is quasi-separated. Step 3 gives h separated of finite type from closed-immersion-proper(a), closed-immersion-finite and finite-over-separated-finite-type, with no finite-generation assumption. These are all Mathlib leaves or definitions, so they are tools, not route. Steps 4-7 are unchanged. The composition node's hypotheses (qcqs schemes, separated finite type for both factors and the composite, arbitrary compactifications) are met by steps 1-3. The compactifications d_U=(j_U,id) and d_Z=(id,i) are valid, Ri_*≅i_* follows from exactness, the triangle-isomorphism squares commute so TR1 applies, and D^+ is a full triangulated subcategory, which gives the LES at every q. Restricting to D^+ for finite Λ is a special case of Stacks' D^+_tors, not a weakening. All step lengths are under 2000 and proof_deps equals the union of uses. A 0GKP grep finds no duplicate. Edge cases checked: U empty, Z empty, K=0, Λ=0, a non-f.g. ideal, and arbitrary compactifications. The five declared tool uses are accepted again and no SGA source is cited. No fixes.
